---
title: "Plain Style"
author: "Norah Jones"
title-block-style: plain
# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z, P6 bd-vkiwhcny): plain keeps
# the full styled DOM but drops the title-block SCSS layer from the
# compiled CSS (Q1's documentTitleScssLayer behavior). (One
# responsive .quarto-title-banner margin rule lives in the bootstrap
# layer — in Q1 too — so the CSS negatives target selectors only the
# title-block layer produces.)
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "header#title-block-header.quarto-title-block.default",
            "div.quarto-title > h1.title",
            "div.quarto-title-meta",
          ]
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - []
        - [
            "\\.quarto-title-meta-heading",
            "\\.quarto-title-author-orcid",
          ]
---

Body.
